title: Combined Wool
description: Adds a lot of wool and carpet combinations with patterns
body:
## Combined Wool
This mod adds a lot of different combinations of wools and carpets.  

### There is now a new 2.0 version and a JEI integration!

## ![Row of modded blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/503e625df6a827fa49a63ca77f12771a2f1d121a.png)

Mod is still in development, but a lot of things are now completed.

There is a new block - **Wool Combiner** (It allows you to combine and also uncombine wools and carpets)
